observations: Three photos show a black Canon DSLR camera body with lens cap on, placed on a wooden surface.
The camera body has 'Canon' branding on the top and 'EOS 5D Mark III' visible on the front right side in photo 0 and photo 1.
The lens cap has 'Canon' embossed on it.
The background includes a white Canon box with 'EOS 5D' visible in photo 1 and photo 2.
The camera appears to be in used condition with some minor scuffs and dust on the body.
No lens is attached; the camera is body-only.
No screen, battery, charger, or accessories are visible in any photo.
The seller's text mentions 'full frame DLSR camera' and 'Canon EOS 5D Mark III'.

claims.evidence: The model name 'EOS 5D Mark III' is clearly visible on the front right of the camera body in photo 0 and photo 1.
The camera body is a full-frame DSLR, as indicated by the 'EOS 5D Mark III' model and the design of the sensor bay and body.

claims.claim: Looking to get a full frame DLSR camera for your photography business?
claims.evidence: This is a general statement about the seller's intent, not a claim about the item itself. Cannot be verified from photos.

claims.claim: Shutter count under 5,000, no fungus or scratch on the lens. Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

Photo of the battery and charger included with the camera.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
